scope: Original missions, copied profiles, muted exact-window capture. TAA at 100 percent world resolution, 1400m view distance. No concurrent builds during timing. Sparse probes disabled during timing. Render-camera sweeps and separately recorded physical player input; not mission completion.
note: Output ROI values are linearized SDR screenshots after AA and presentation, not radiometric calibration. Small signed ground component differences can be sampling/cloud noise. Timings are short interval medians, not a universal speedup claim.

malden-1080.note: Both executables rechecked with populated scene/pipeline caches. Initial updated intervals varied in draw counts and are retained separately, not reported as a negative GI cost.

cpuDrawComparison.note: Actual baseline versus final in the same warmed Malden yard. CPU command time includes renderer/driver recording and is not a pure geometry-preparation timer.

diagnosticFailure.note: Both runs failed before compaction; neither is counted in final passing validation. The final native/CPU/native Everon run completes. Old exception reporting did not retain the VkResult code.
